events.title: Cayucos Fall Antique Street Faire
events.venue: Ocean Ave between E St & Cayucos Dr, Cayucos CA
events.summary: Outdoor antique & collectibles street faire closing Ocean Ave to traffic, 7am–3pm. Rain or shine; leashed dogs welcome.

events.title: 35th Annual Cayucos Car Show
events.summary: Classic car show along downtown Cayucos, 8am–4pm, with live band, beer garden & Lions BBQ. Fri Nov 6 check-in party at Nelson's Garage.

events.title: Christmas in Cayucos – Tree Lighting & Holiday Open House
events.venue: Corner of D St & Ocean Ave / Ocean Ave businesses, Cayucos CA
events.summary: Free community tree lighting at 5pm with carolers, Santa arriving by fire engine, plus holiday open house on Ocean Ave shops 4–7pm.

events.title: Schooners Open Mic Night
events.venue: Schooners, 171 N. Ocean Ave, Cayucos CA
events.summary: Free weekly open mic every Wednesday at 7pm, year-round at Schooners' oceanview deck in Cayucos.

events.title: Schooners Beachside Live – Weekend Concert Series
events.window: Saturdays & Sundays, free live music, May through October
events.venue: Schooners, 171 N. Ocean Ave, Cayucos CA
events.summary: Free outdoor weekend concerts on Schooners' beachside patio featuring local & touring acts, Saturdays & Sundays through end of October.
